ntty_format_ground_truth.method: full Unicorn emulation of parse_NTY (0x39ddab4) on the plaintext RES.DAT.00 with a fake IO::Stream (tools/m3d_emu_nty_full.py)
ntty_format_ground_truth.header: BE fields: u16 magic 0x4d4d 'MM', u16 0x002a, u32 = volume-data end / metadata offset, u16 = volume count, u32

volume_entry_fields.+0x25f: flags top byte — bit 0x40 = GZIP (GzStreamInflater path)
volume_entry_fields.+0x274: u32 cache stamp A (custom hash, not crc32/adler)
volume_entry_fields.+0x288: u32 cache stamp B (gzip volumes only)

cache_write_path.decryptWriteCache: 0x1f1c914 — volume acquire (0x39def6c flags=2) -> decoderFromKeydesc(0x1f1cc78) -> 8KB decrypt loop -> write to the cache stream (open flags 0x2c000000); flags-byte-0x40 volumes decode via GzStreamInflater (vtable 0x414a858) instead
cache_write_path.cache_layout: root = GNPCACHE, dir = %02X (top nibble of the 31-rolling-hash of the name), file = name@version ('%s/%02X/%s@%s' @0x1365885)
cache_write_path.cache_stamp: 0x39e4464(path, global 0x41b61b0) compared against entry+0x274 (or +0x288 for gzip volumes) to decide re-creation
cache_write_path.keydesc_flow: NtyCacheDescriptor {NtyReader ctx@+8, flag@+0x18, keydesc@+0x20} -> decoderFromKeydesc reads keydesc+8 -> 0x39d3fd0 keySpecFromDesc -> BQ1599BisqueKey (vtable 0x3fd6b48) -> decoder class by class-bits (Plane/159/144/40SE)

encrypted_nty_key_record.installer: sigInstall 0x39dea94 (called from parse_NTY via PLT 0x3fa2af0 with NtyReader::open's 3rd arg)
encrypted_nty_key_record.record_layout: {u32 id@+0, sig[0x24]@+4, u32 payload_len@+0x28, u32 crc32@+0x2c, u32 @+0x30, encrypted NTY payload@+0x34}
encrypted_nty_key_record.mechanism: the record's 36-byte signature doubles as the key: keyExpand(ctx+0x457, 0x20 bytes, mode 0x40000000) -> RC4-255 decrypt of record+0x34 (payload_len bytes) -> crc32 verify -> destroy the ctx volume list -> re-parse the NTY from the decrypted buffer
encrypted_nty_key_record.signature_check: the caller-supplied record must match the NTY-embedded record (5 qword/dword fields); ntyOpenCaller2 (0x3a08a00) also memcmp's a 0x24-byte key signature at NtyReader ctx+0x28
